
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {

	public static void main(String[] args) {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub
		Scanner in = new Scanner(System.in);
		int n = in.nextInt();
		UF uf = new UF(n);
		int root =-1;
		int[] a = new int[n];
		int ans =0;
		int re=0;
		for(int i =0; i< n; i++) {
			int p = in.nextInt()-1;
			if(p==i){
				root =i+1;
				a[i]=-1;
				re++;
			} else if(!uf.union(p, i)){
				a[i]=-1;
				ans++;
				if(root==-1)  root = i+1;
			} else 
				a[i]=p+1;
		}
		
		if(re>0) re--;
		System.out.println(re+ans);
		
		for(int i =0; i<n; i++) {
			int p = a[i]==-1? root: a[i];
			System.out.print(p+" ");
		}
				
	}
	
	static class UF {
		int[] p, rank;
		UF(int n){
			p = new int[n];
			rank= new int[n];
			for(int i =0; i<n ;i++) {
				p[i]=i;
			}
		}
		
		int find(int x) {
			if(x!=p[x]){
				p[x]= find(p[x]);
			}
			return p[x];
		}
		
		boolean union(int x , int y) {
			x = find(x);
			y = find(y);
			if(x==y) return false;
			if(rank[x]>rank[y]){
				p[y]=x;
			} else {
				p[x] =y;
				if(rank[x]==rank[y]) rank[y]++;
			}  return true;
		}
	}
	
	
}
